text:
mira: CI on main is failing when pulling our private ECR image, started ~10m ago. getting 403 AccessDenied from ECR during setup. link to run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890
ci-bot: [failed] job: build-container (self-hosted-us-west) — steps: checkout -> pull-base-image -> error 403
sam: is this the self-hosted fleet or GH-hosted runners?
mira: self-hosted runners in us-west (k8s pool). the step that fails is `docker pull <account>.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/base:latest`
alex: can you paste the last 10 lines of the runner log where it does `aws ecr get-login-password`?
mira: sure, gist: https://gist.github.com/mira/abcdef
```
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z Running: aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2
2026-03-17T14:02:12Z ERROR: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the GetAuthorizationToken operation: User: arn:aws:sts::111111111111:assumed-role/infra-deploy/i-0123456789abcdef is not authorized to perform: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken on resource: *
```
jamie: hmm we just did IAM cleanup yesterday and removed some permissions from infra-deploy to tighten secrets access. didn't think ECR token was impacted — I'll check the change list
alex: this sounds like the credentials refresh sidecar (running on the runner pod) lost permissions to call STS/ECR. that sidecar fetches a secret via SecretsManager which itself needs kms:Decrypt when using customer KMS. could be a cascade: removed secretsmanager or kms permissions during the cleanup
jamie: confirming — PR #5423 removed `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` from infra-deploy role as part of the vault rollout. that would block the refresh path if the sidecar reads docker creds from SecretsManager
infra-oncall: I can restore a minimal policy to unblock CI, will add `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` and `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken` back to infra-deploy; doing it now and will post the change id
sam: if you restore, can someone trigger a rerun? this is blocking multiple PRs
mira: will request a rerun after infra-oncall confirms
infra-oncall: policy updated (iam-change-id: iam-CHG-20260317-001). added secretsmanager:GetSecretValue and ecr:GetAuthorizationToken scoped to our account. give it 30s for propagation
alex: also double-check the KMS key policy if SecretsManager uses a customer CMK — restored role needs kms:Decrypt on the key alias/redwood/secrets
jamie: KMS policy looks good for infra-deploy; I also rotated the SecretsManager secret version to force refresh once sidecar has perms
mira: re-running the failed workflow now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567891
ci-bot: [queued] build-container (self-hosted-us-west) — retriggered by mira
ci-bot: [started] build-container -> pull-base-image
mira: tests are back to green :party: build-container succeeded and image pulled fine
sam: awesome, thanks infra-oncall and jamie for the quick fix. can we add a checklist to the IAM cleanup playbook to run a CI smoke test after changes?\alex: +1, also add a note to validate SecretsManager + KMS combos; they're easy to miss
jamie: will add a post-cleanup smoke step to the runbook and open a follow-up PR to automate a quick CI smoke on iam changes
infra-oncall: marked incident as resolved iam-CHG-20260317-001; reachable if it recurs
mira: thanks everyone, closing thread
